note: QUALITY eval — grades the QUALITY of ingest output, separate from evals.json (which only tests should_trigger routing). The ingest pipeline's quality is LLM-driven (summary generation, concept/entity extraction, HITL judgement), so it is graded by an LLM judge against assertions/eval-*.json on REAL output — not asserted deterministically. Run as a with_skill vs without_skill A/B (the skill should beat the no-skill baseline); see README.md. The deterministic CI guard (tests/agents/robin/test_ingest_eval_spec.py) only validates that this spec is well-formed.
